description: Fetch an IMF time series. Identify the series by dataset plus a `dimensions` map of named codes, e.g. get_data({dataset:"CPI", dimensions:{COUNTRY:"USA", INDEX_TYPE:"CPI", COICOP_1999:"_T", TYPE_OF_TRANSFORMATION:"IX", FREQUENCY:"M"}, start:"2024-01"}). Dimension names and order differ per dataset — use search_indicators to see what a dataset accepts. Any dimension you omit is left open, returning every code for it. Returns observations as {period, value} plus the dimension values of each series.

dimensions.description: Map of dimension code to value, e.g. {"COUNTRY":"USA","FREQUENCY":"M"}. A value may be a list to OR codes together: {"COUNTRY":["USA","GBR"]}. Omitted dimensions match everything. Use search_indicators to discover valid names and codes.

name: get_data

outputSchema.description: IMF SDMX CompactData response with time-series observations

title: Get Data
